questionText:
Consider the routing protocols given in List I and the names given in List II:

List I List II
(i)    Distance vector routing (a)    Bellman-Ford
(ii)   Link state routing (b)    Dijkstra

For matching of items in List I with those in List II, which ONE of the following options is CORRECT?
explanation:
Step-by-step Explanation:

• Distance vector routing (i): Operates based on the Bellman-Ford algorithm, where each router maintains a vector of distances to all destinations and periodically updates its neighbors. Hence, (i) matches with (a).

• Link state routing (ii): Operates based on Dijkstra's algorithm, where each router learns the complete network topology and independently calculates the shortest path to every other node. Hence, (ii) matches with (b).

Therefore, the correct matching is (i) – (a) and (ii) – (b), which corresponds to Option (A).
